unit.why: A short anecdote about a tzaddik whose wife secretly built him a house with money taken from him, ending with his exegesis of a verse.

stories.start_quote: ידוע שדרכו בקודש היה תמיד ליתן
stories.summary_en: A tzaddik who always gave away everything to charity is shown by his disciples a house his wife secretly built with money taken from him, and he interprets 'house and wealth are the inheritance of fathers, but a prudent wife is from God'.

quotes: תמיד ליתן צדקה כל אשר לו
tags.why: He habitually gave all he had to charity

quotes: ולא נתן לצרכי ביתו רק חיי שעה בצמצום
tags.why: Voluntary austerity, keeping only bare necessities
The tale illustrates his charity and indifference to property

quotes: גנבה אשתו אצלו איזה סך ובנתה לו בית
tags.why: His wife is a key character

quotes: גנבה אשתו אצלו איזה סך ובנתה לו בית
tags.why: The wife acts on her own initiative and drives the plot

quotes: הבית הזה הוא שלו שאשתו בנתה לו
tags.why: The wife provides for the household behind her husband's back
The wife secretly takes money; the disciples conceal it
The disciples fear the master and contrive to show him the house
The tzaddik responds with an exegesis of Proverbs 19:14

quotes: והוכרחו לגלות לו שהבית הזה הוא שלו
tags.why: He belatedly learns that the house is his

missing_concepts: the wife as provider of the household (a prudent wife)
the tzaddik's indifference to property and dwelling
